name: Example · Dragon over the Golden Gate

golden-gate-run.direction: Muse, an armoured knight with a red plume and blue tabard, rides a colossal charcoal dragon with oxblood wings through the Golden Gate Bridge on a clear day: low over six lanes of traffic between the cables, wings tucked through the south tower portal, out between the suspenders and down into the bay. Under water it glides through blue-green murk past kelp and rocks, then bursts out in front of the bridge and climbs with heavy wingbeats as he raises his sword. Bright blue sky, ocean fog, enormous scale, preserving the previs path, timing and cuts.

assets.name: Muse (stand-in)
assets.description: Plain ellipsoid stand-in for Muse: one body, one arm and a sword.

assets.name: Dragon (stand-in)
assets.description: Plain stand-in for the dragon: ellipsoid body, neck, head, legs and tail, with simple wings. Saddled.

assets.name: Flight Rig
assets.description: Invisible 5 mm pivot used to aim a flying performer: yaw on one level, pitch and roll on the next.

assets.name: Golden Gate Bridge
assets.description: Near-real-scale Golden Gate Bridge in international orange: two 227 m towers 1280 m apart, deck 67 m above the water, main cables, suspenders every 30 m, side spans to the anchorages. Water level is y = 0.

assets.name: Bay Water
assets.description: Flat water surface for the Golden Gate strait, 2 km by 1.4 km at scale 100; its top is the water level and its underside is the surface seen from below.

assets.name: Headland
assets.description: Rounded coastal hill, flattened ellipsoid, scale it up for headlands.

assets.name: Fog Bank
assets.description: Soft low fog bank, flattened ellipsoid, scale it up.

assets.name: Seabed
assets.description: Muddy green seabed block; its top is the sea floor, scale it up.

assets.name: Underwater Murk
assets.description: Opaque wall of deep blue-green water that closes off the underwater view, scale it up.
